definitionEn: n. unnecessary and unforeseen trouble resulting from an unfortunate event\nn. an unfortunate state resulting from unfavorable outcomes

example.translationZh: 他在回家的路上车被偷了，遭遇了一场不幸。

example.translationZh: 她对没有仔细阅读就签署合同一事感到疑虑。

definitionZh: vt. 使无效, 废弃, 取消\n[化] 使等于零; 作废

example.text: The court decided to nullify the contract because it had been signed under pressure.
example.translationZh: 法院决定使该合同无效，因为它是在压力下签署的。

definitionEn: v. make numb or insensitive\ns. so frightened as to be unable to move; stunned or paralyzed with terror; petrified
definitionZh: a. 麻木的, 失去知觉的\nvt. 使麻木, 使昏迷, 使失去知觉

example.text: My fingers went numb with cold after waiting outside for an hour.
example.translationZh: 在外面等了一个小时后，我的手指冻得麻木了。

definitionEn: a. relating to or having ability to think in or work with numbers
definitionZh: a. 数字的, 数值的, 以数字表示的, 擅长于计数的\n[经] 数字的, 用数字表示的

example.text: The researchers entered all the numerical data into a spreadsheet for analysis.
example.translationZh: 研究人员将所有数值数据输入电子表格进行分析。

definitionEn: s. amounting to a large indefinite number
definitionZh: a. 很多的, 数目众多的, 多数的\n[机] 多数的, 甚多的

example.text: The new policy has created numerous opportunities for small businesses.
example.translationZh: 新政策为小企业创造了众多机会。

definitionEn:
n. one skilled in caring for young children or the sick (usually under the supervision of a physician)
v. try to cure by special care of treatment, of an illness or injury
v. serve as a nurse; care for sick or handicapped people
v. treat carefully
definitionZh: n. 护士, 保姆, 奶妈\nvt. 看护, 照顾, 培养\nvi. 喂奶, 看护病人

example.text: The young nurse stayed by the patient's bedside all night.
example.translationZh: 那位年轻护士整夜守在病人床边。

definitionEn: n. a child's room for a baby
definitionZh: n. 托儿所, 苗圃, 温床\n[医] 婴儿室, 托儿所

example.text: She drops her daughter off at the nursery before work every morning.
example.translationZh: 她每天早上上班前把女儿送到托儿所。

definitionEn: n. the work of caring for the sick or injured or infirm\nn. the profession of a nurse\nn. nourishing at the breast
definitionZh: n. 看护, 养育\n[医] 护理[法], 喂乳[法]

example.text: She decided to pursue a career in nursing after volunteering at a local hospital.
example.translationZh: 在当地医院做志愿者后，她决定从事护理职业。

definitionEn:
n the properties acquired as a consequence of the way you were treated as a child
n helping someone grow up to be an accepted member of the community
v help develop, help grow
v bring up
v provide with nourishment
definitionZh: n. 养育, 营养物, 培育\nvt. 养育, 供给营养物, 教养

example.text: Good teachers know how to nurture talent in every student.
example.translationZh: 好老师懂得如何培养每个学生的才能。

definitionEn: n. (physiology) the organic process of nourishing or being nourished; the processes by which an organism assimilates food and uses it for growth and maintenance\nn. the scientific study of food and drink (especially in humans)
definitionZh: n. 营养, 营养学\n[医] 营养, 营养品

example.text: Good nutrition is essential for children's growth and development.
example.translationZh: 良好的营养对儿童的生长发育至关重要。

definitionEn:
n usually large hard-shelled seed
n Egyptian goddess of the sky
n a small (usually square or hexagonal) metal block with internal screw thread to be fitted onto a bolt
n half the width of an em
n a whimsically eccentric person
n someone who is so ardently devoted to something that it resembles an addiction
n one of the two male reproductive glands that produce spermatozoa and secrete androgens
v gather nuts
s informal or slang terms for mentally irregular
definitionZh: a. 狂热的, 发狂的, 疯的\ninterj. 呸, 胡说

example.text: She is nuts about old jazz records and spends every weekend hunting for them.
example.translationZh: 她对老爵士唱片非常着迷，每个周末都花时间去淘。

definitionEn: n. a thermoplastic polyamide; a family of strong resilient synthetic fibers\nn. a synthetic fabric
definitionZh: n. 尼龙\n[化] 尼龙; 聚酰胺纤维

example.text: This jacket is made of lightweight nylon fabric that dries quickly.
example.translationZh: 这件夹克由轻质尼龙面料制成，干得很快。

definitionEn: n. an implement used to propel or steer a boat
definitionZh: n. 桨, 桨手, 搅棒\nvi. 划桨\nvt. 划动

example.text: She pulled hard on the oar to keep the boat steady in the current.
example.translationZh: 她用力划桨，让船在激流中保持平稳。

definitionEn: n. a fertile tract in a desert (where the water table approaches the surface)
definitionZh: n. 绿洲, 舒适的地方\n[医] 绿洲(沙漠中), 健岛(病变区中的健康组织)

example.text: The travelers were relieved to find an oasis in the desert after walking for days.
example.translationZh: 走了几天之后，旅行者们如释重负地在沙漠中找到了一片绿洲。

definitionEn: n. a commitment to tell the truth (especially in a court of law); to lie under oath is to become subject to prosecution for perjury\nn. a solemn promise, usually invoking a divine witness, regarding your future acts or behavior
definitionZh: n. 誓约, 誓言, 咒骂\n[法] 誓言, 誓约, 宣誓

example.text: The witness had to take an oath before giving evidence in court.
example.translationZh: 证人在法庭作证前必须宣誓。

definitionEn: a. dutifully complying with the commands or instructions of those in authority; the refractory remain unburdened"- Edmund Burke
definitionZh: a. 服从的, 顺从的, 孝顺的\n[法] 服从的, 顺从的, 忠顺的

example.text: The children were quiet and obedient while their grandmother was visiting.
example.translationZh: 奶奶来访时，孩子们安静又听话。

definitionEn:
n. a tangible and visible entity; an entity that can cast a shadow
n. (grammar) a constituent that is acted upon
n. the focus of cognitions or feelings
n. (computing) a discrete item that provides a description of virtually anything known to a computer
definitionZh:
n. 物体, 目标, 目的, 对象, 宾语, 客体
vi. 反对, 抱反感
vt. 提出...来反对
[计] 对象

example.text: Many residents object to the plan to build a new airport near their homes.
example.translationZh: 许多居民反对在他们家附近建新机场的计划。

definitionEn: n. the speech act of objecting\nn. (law) a procedure whereby a party to a suit says that a particular line of questioning or a particular witness or a piece of evidence or other matter is improper and should not be continued and asks the court to rule on its impropriety or illegality
definitionZh: n. 异议, 反对, 不喜欢, 缺点, 缺陷, 妨碍, 拒绝之理由\n[法] 异议, 反对, 抗议

example.text: The lawyer raised an objection when the witness began to speculate about events she had not seen.
example.translationZh: 当证人开始推测她并未亲眼所见的事情时，律师提出了异议。

definitionEn: n the goal intended to be attained (and which is believed to be attainable)\nn the lens or system of lenses in a telescope or microscope that is nearest the object being viewed
definitionZh: n. 目标( objective的名词复数 ); [光学]（望远镜、显微镜、照相机及其他光学仪器上的）物镜; [语法学]1)。 宾语 2)。 宾格; [军事]出击目标

example.text: The team worked hard to achieve its objectives by the end of the year.
example.translationZh: 团队努力工作，以在年底前实现其目标。

definitionEn: n. the state of being obligated to do or pay something\nn. a personal relation in which one is indebted for a service or favor\nn. a legal agreement specifying a payment or action and the penalty for failure to comply
definitionZh: n. 义务, 责任, 约束, 契约, 恩惠, 债务\n[经] 待付款, 债务, 义务

example.text: The company must meet its financial obligations before the end of the quarter.
example.translationZh: 公司必须在季度末之前履行其财务义务。

definitionEn: a. morally or legally constraining or binding\ns. required by obligation or compulsion or convention
definitionZh: a. 义务的, 必须的, 强制性的\n[法] 有拘束的, 强制的, 必须的

example.text: Attendance at the safety training session is obligatory for all new employees.
example.translationZh: 所有新员工都必须参加安全培训课程。
